title: Transition square for the explicit common-stage dual
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with algebraically closed field k of characteristic p, a prime l different from p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l in an independent universe, and a separated, quasi-compact, locally finite-type k-scheme X. Use the actual rational finite stages C_E, their scalar extensions T_h, and the literal common-stage pair category P of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let F be Finite data and let hF be FiniteCoherent as defined in [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data]; thus d_E=(F.datum E).dual has the rational Verdier structures and normalized beta comparisons of [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Let V=descendedDual F hF and r_E=descendedComparison F hF E be the fixed constructions of [lem-coef-qbar-verdier-representative-functor]. For E≤L and K∈C_E, j_L(β_h(K)) ; r_L(T_h K) ; V((inclusionTransition_h).inv(K)).op equals (inclusionTransition_h).hom(d_E K) ; r_E(K). The maps and their order are the normalized maps, including for repeated fields.

proof.text: Expand the inclusion-transition map as its common-stage representative. Its image under a stage-system morphism is mapAt; the generic cocycle equation with the second extension the identity, followed by cancellation of beta inverse, gives the stated square. This is proved directly in Lean as transition_square and then specialized to the opposite stages.

lean.statement:
theorem descended_comparison_formula (F : Finite D l hl Ω X)
    (hF : FiniteCoherent D l hl Ω X F) :
    ∀ (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) (K : Stage l Ω X E),
      (inclusion L).map ((F.beta E L h).hom.app (op K)) ≫
        (descendedComparison D l hl Ω X F hF L).hom.app
          (op ((transition l Ω X E L h).obj K)) ≫
        (descendedDual D l hl Ω X F hF).map
          ((inclusionTransition l Ω X E L h).inv.app K).op =
      (inclusionTransition l Ω X E L h).hom.app ((F.datum E).dual.obj (op K)) ≫
        (descendedComparison D l hl Ω X F hF E).hom.app (op K)
